task.title: Strengthen state graph read models
task.summary: Reduce any usage and cognitive complexity in graph, builders, reader, and lint code while preserving generated CodeWiki state outputs.

goal.outcome: State graph/read-model ownership has stronger typing and smaller focused modules without generated output drift.
acceptance: Major JSON and graph inputs parse as unknown and narrow through domain guards or existing state/roadmap/session types.
High-count any/as any usage in state/builders, state/reader, graph, and lint paths is reduced measurably.
Graph input collection, node/edge construction, reconciliation/scope views, and output writing are separated enough to lower complexity in the graph owner file.
Generated graph/status/task context/lint outputs remain schema-compatible with existing smoke tests.
non_goals: Do not redesign the graph JSON schema.
Do not move state ownership out of src/state/**.
Do not change resume task-selection logic; TASK-040 owns that boundary.
verification: rerun type-coverage and complexity review for state files

delta.desired: State read models are typed and modular enough for maintainable follow-up changes.
delta.current: State graph/builders/reader/lint files are top complexity and any-typed hotspots.
delta.closure: Task closes when tests pass and review metrics improve for targeted state files.
